Definition

Bjorling's problem: the minimal surface through a given curve with a given normal along it. Embedded minimal surfaces invariant under a screw motion composed with a homothety: bent helicoids following a logarithmically spiraling helix, embedded in an invariant tube around it (Breiner-Kleene 2014).

  • C. Breiner and S. Kleene, 'Logarithmically spiraling helicoids', arXiv:1404.6996 (2014).
